name: Vanilla Dream
description: Creamy and smooth vanilla ice cream made with rich milk and real vanilla flavor.
longDescription: Vanilla Dream is a timeless classic for ice cream lovers. Its smooth, creamy texture and rich vanilla flavor make every scoop simple, refreshing and delicious.

name: Chocolate Fudge
description: Rich chocolate ice cream with a delicious fudgy flavor for chocolate lovers.
longDescription: Chocolate Fudge combines a rich chocolate base with a smooth fudgy taste. It is perfect for anyone who enjoys a deep and creamy chocolate experience.

name: Strawberry Swirl
description: Sweet strawberry ice cream blended with a refreshing strawberry swirl.
longDescription: Strawberry Swirl brings together creamy ice cream and a fruity strawberry swirl. Its sweet and refreshing flavor makes it a great choice for warm days.

name: Mango Delight
description: A refreshing mango ice cream made for a delicious tropical experience.
longDescription: Mango Delight is inspired by the sweet and refreshing taste of ripe mangoes. Its creamy texture and fruity flavor bring a tropical feeling to every scoop.

name: Cookies & Cream
description: Creamy vanilla ice cream loaded with crunchy chocolate cookie pieces.
longDescription: Cookies & Cream combines smooth vanilla ice cream with crunchy chocolate cookie pieces. Every spoonful gives you a delicious mix of creamy and crunchy textures.

name: Blueberry Cheesecake
description: Smooth blueberry cheesecake ice cream with a creamy and fruity taste.
longDescription: Blueberry Cheesecake combines a creamy cheesecake-inspired base with a sweet blueberry flavor. It is a premium choice for customers who enjoy fruity and creamy desserts together.

name: Chocolate Fudge Sundae
description: A delicious chocolate fudge sundae topped with creamy goodness.
longDescription: Chocolate Fudge Sundae is a rich dessert experience featuring creamy chocolate ice cream and a delicious fudge topping. It is perfect when you want something extra special.
